🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
A solid weekend in Tesoro Highlands—something for everyone.

🎬 *Fri* — City Cinemas, presented by Henry Rodriguez State Farm: Jurassic Park
   Outdoor movie night—classic fun for the whole family.
🏍️ *Sat 9 AM* — Motorcycles and Coffee (free)
   Casual Sunday morning, free, local gathering spot.
🎵 *Sat 7 PM* — Concerts in the Park, presented by Logix Federal Credit Union: Police Tribute
   Live concert in the park—great for families and adults.
🦘 *Sun* — Visit The Gentle Barn (from $15)
   Animal encounters for kids; adults enjoy the setting too.
🥬 *Sun 8 AM* — Santa Clarita Certified Farmers Market
   Fresh local produce and weekend vibe—neighborhood staple.
🎭 *Fri 8 PM* — The Lightning Thief: The Percy Jackson Musical at Canyon Theatre Guild
   Evening musical theater—Percy Jackson fans will love it.
